verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is a consumer graphics card, not a networked service or SaaS with a web API, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence does not show the card itself shipping such a spec: the OpenAPI probe paths on the developer portal all return 404, and CUDA/SDK mentions are programming toolkits, not machine-readable API specs for the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
